overview: Roadie Roster manages hiring, orientation and opening-week staffing for a new store, with a demo mode for safe practice.
features: Track roadies through pending and active roster states
Schedule orientation sessions and assign roadies automatically
Gate orientation on completed paperwork with a due date
Check roadies in at orientation with a uniform check-off
Set per-position uniform defaults for shirts and hats
Flag and archive no-shows with new archive reasons
Keep demo data fully separate from real records
